notes: λέγων is unrepresented under rule 37 because its English stands at the end of MAT.3.1; a reference comparison will report it as a disagreement and that report is not a correction.

καί is unrepresented because the ASV writes no connective at this seam; SBLGNT.MAT.3.2.v001 is underdetermined with r00-base still compatible, so this is rule 23 and not a new textual decision under rule 12.
Heading ἤγγικεν on is rather than hand remains defensible, but rule 17 forbids the copula and rule 71's ἐγγύς → is at hand precedent heads on hand.
